# Glass Painting

> Glass Painting is a family-owned, licensed and insured residential painting contractor based in Braselton, Georgia. We paint the interiors and exteriors of single-family homes and have been in business for over 40 years. Estimates are free, with no obligation.

## Contact

- Phone (call or text): (770) 403-7608
- Email: glasspaintingga@gmail.com
- Website: https://glasspainting.homes/
- Request a free estimate: https://glasspainting.homes/#estimate

## Services

- Interior painting: walls and ceilings, trim and baseboards, doors and frames, crown molding, drywall patching, and color changes.
- Exterior painting: siding; trim, fascia and soffits; doors and shutters; garage doors; porches and railings; washing and prep.
- Single-family homes only. We do not take commercial buildings or apartment complexes.

## Service area

Braselton, Hoschton, Chateau Élan, Jefferson, Buford, Hamilton Mill, Flowery Branch, Oakwood, Gainesville, Auburn, Dacula, and Winder, Georgia, plus nearby communities across parts of Jackson, Gwinnett, Hall, and Barrow counties.

## About

- Family owned and operated for more than 40 years.
- Licensed and insured.
- Nearly all of our work has come from referrals by past customers.

## How it works

1. Reach out by phone, text, email, or the estimate form.
2. Free estimate: we visit in person, talk through colors and options, and give a clear quote.
3. Prep and paint: thorough surface prep, then quality paint applied with care.
4. Final walkthrough: we review the finished job with you before calling it done.

## Frequently asked questions

- Free estimates? Yes, free and with no obligation.
- Licensed and insured? Yes.
- Commercial work? No, single-family homes only, interior and exterior.
- Colors chosen before the estimate? Not needed. We talk through colors and options during the visit.
